summary: Bound launchctl subprocesses, skip overlapping probes and report stalled launchd with capped backoff instead of accumulating hung children.

replay.detail: No claim format or replay change.

compatibility.detail: Every launchctl invocation has a three-second deadline with kill and wait cleanup. Each process admits one invocation at a time; overlapping calls skip. After timeouts, requests back off for 5, 10, 20, 40 and at most 60 seconds. Daemon health adds an optional service_manager object with launchd-unresponsive reason, since and next-retry Unix milliseconds, and consecutive timeout count. A completed RPC clears the failure.

downtime.detail: Restart the daemon to activate the bounded runner; no state migration is required.

manual.detail: No new configuration. Linux fake-command tests cover the runner and deterministic gate; a real macOS launchd stall is not exercised.

recovery.detail: A responsive launchd clears the recorded failure on the next admitted RPC; this does not repair the launchd stall itself.
